parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of setting a session header to None, but it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the merge_setting function.

issues.description: The patch modifies the merge_setting function to remove headers with None values, which is not directly related to the issue of setting a session header to None. This change may have unintended side effects and is not minimal.
